transcript.description: The call transcript, pasted (Zoom VTT, Google Meet transcript or 'Speaker: text' lines). Absent or shortened: the skill reads the recorder step's output. Cited as input:transcript.

segment.description: The customer's segment label, e.g. Mid-market SaaS. Copied onto every row; never the company name. Default: unspecified.

company.description: The customer's company name, to remove from every insight.

our_side.description: Names of the people on the seller's side, and the seller's company. Their turns are never insights.

redact_terms.description: Extra words to remove wherever they appear: codenames, a parent company, a customer of theirs.

call_key.description: A stable id for this call, e.g. a recorder record id. Counts calls and prevents storing the same call twice.

call_date.description: The call date, YYYY-MM-DD. Else the record's date.

repeat_threshold.description: Calls needed to flag a pain as repeated.

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601, for report.meta (and the fallback call_key). Optional: on JoyStream the template binds it to the run start time. Never guessed.
